scenarios.title: An object's color comes from its mana cost, a color indicator or a characteristic-defining ability, not its frame
decisions: No spells or abilities are used; both players pass priority with an empty stack.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears, with mana cost {1}{G}, is green and only green (monocolored).

variants.label: multicolor
variants.delta: A's permanent is Watchwolf (mana cost {G}{W}) instead of Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: colorless_cost
variants.delta: A's permanent is Wurmcoil Engine (mana cost {6}, an artifact) instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Wurmcoil Engine has no color symbol in its mana cost and is colorless.

variants.label: color_indicator
variants.delta: A's permanent is Dryad Arbor (no mana cost, color indicator green) instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Dryad Arbor is green even though it has no mana cost.

variants.label: cda
variants.delta: A's permanent is Transguild Courier (mana cost {4}, characteristic-defining ability making it all colors) instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Transguild Courier is white, blue, black, red and green.

scenarios.forge_notes: Each variant swaps the single permanent on A's battlefield.

scenarios.title: An effect that gives an object a new color replaces its colors unless it adds the color or makes the object colorless
decisions: A casts Prismatic Lace targeting Grizzly Bears, choosing blue, tapping one Island.
Both players pass priority; Prismatic Lace resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears becomes blue only; its green is replaced.

variants.label: in_addition
variants.delta: A casts Painter's Servant (tapping two Islands) and chooses blue, instead of casting Prismatic Lace.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is green and blue; its green is kept because the new color is added in addition.

operation.unclassifiable: a different spell cast: A casts a creature with a colour-adding static instead of the colour-setting instant, which also adds a permanent

variants.label: colorless
variants.delta: A casts Moonlace targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping one Island, instead of casting Prismatic Lace.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears becomes colorless and loses green.

operation.unclassifiable: a different spell cast: A casts a make-colourless instant instead

variants.label: colorless_target
variants.delta: Prismatic Lace targets Ornithopter and A chooses blue.
variants.expected: Ornithopter, a colorless artifact creature, becomes blue.

operation.unclassifiable: a different target for the same spell

scenarios.forge_notes: Prismatic Lace and Moonlace apply an Animate effect with permanent duration. Painter's Servant's static ability colors every permanent, so once it enters Ornithopter and Painter's Servant itself are blue too.

detector.outcome: A continuous effect sets an entity's colours outright (a '=' colour line), replacing every colour it had.
detector.near_miss: A continuous effect that applies to the board and sets no colour, such as one adding a colour in addition to the others.
